defect.reproducer: Run patrol without remap. /cmd_vel has 1 publisher and 0 subscribers; /turtle1/cmd_vel has 0 publishers and 1 turtlesim subscriber. After the first pose patrol publishes linear.x=0.5 and angular.z=0.3, but two pose snapshots 1.5 seconds apart are identical.
defect.root_cause: Relative cmd_vel resolves to /cmd_vel in the root namespace; turtlesim listens to the different fully qualified name /turtle1/cmd_vel. Type, QoS, ROS domain and command values are unchanged.
defect.proof_after: Restart only patrol with --ros-args -r cmd_vel:=/turtle1/cmd_vel. The corrected topic has 1 patrol publisher and 1 turtlesim subscriber; pose velocities are 0.5 and approximately 0.3. 100 command samples arrive in a 10-second window (10.0 Hz); the CLI estimate is 10.001 Hz. After SIGINT the observed stop takes 0.974 seconds.
